quote(bytes,uint256).details: Not marked `view` because many DEX quoters use state-reverting simulation.

params.amountIn: Amount of input token to quote

swap(bytes,uint256,uint256,address).details: Caller must have approved this adapter for `amountIn` of the input token.      The adapter transfers tokens from caller, approves the DEX router,      and routes output tokens to `recipient`.

params.amountIn: Exact amount of input token to swap
params.path: DEX-encoded swap path (token addresses + fees as needed)
params.recipient: Address that receives the output tokens

returns.amountOut: Actual amount of output token received

quote(bytes,uint256).notice: Quote the expected output for an exact-input swap without executing.

userdoc.notice: ISwapAdapter implementation for Algebra-based DEXes (Camelot V3, etc.).         Caller provides a pre-encoded Algebra path: (tokenIn ++ tokenOut) per hop (no fee bytes).
